dead_ends: LOC search with facet 'fa=partof:historic american buildings survey' + 'Fort Tejon' returned 0 results (facet string mismatch); a plain keyword search 'Fort Tejon Historic American Buildings Survey' surfaced the HABS items ca0189-ca0194.
Direct curl of calisphere.org item/search pages returns HTTP 202 with 0-byte body (bot challenge); Calisphere metadata obtainable only via the browser tool, not WebFetch/curl.

USC Digital Library image host thumbnails.digitallibrary.usc.edu unreachable in this environment (curl returns HTTP 000 / SSL failure), so the public-domain 'Cattle on Tejon Ranch' (CHS-45819) could not be downloaded here though it is PD/CC-BY.
Calisphere collection-facet URL param (fa=collection:'Kern County Local History Photograph Collection') did not filter results; had to identify Kern items by ark:/13030 IDs.
loc.gov item/search pages 403 to WebFetch; the ?fo=json API works via curl with a browser User-Agent.
notes: All items depict the Kern County Tejon Ranch (Rancho El Tejón, Beale) near Tejon/Lebec — NOT to be confused with any similarly named place. Fort Tejon (Lebec) sits on land that was part of Beale's ranch.

The 101-item 'Southern California Edison Photographs and Negatives' block on Calisphere for 'Tejon Ranch' is the Big Creek Transmission Line crossing the ranch — infrastructure right-of-way, only tangential to cattle operations; not individually catalogued here.
Richest cattle-operation imagery: Huntington LA Times Company Records (restricted) and the un-digitized 169-photo set in the Tejon Ranch Company Records at Sherman Library (physical).
16 Library of Congress items (10 photos/map + 6 HABS Fort Tejon) downloaded and verified as real JPEGs, all 'No known restrictions on publication.'
